ranking_rule: Suitability was ranked from availability/scale metadata only (patient/environment counts, modality lists, on-store paths, technology/platform notes) before any MORPHEUS discovery run, novelty check or literature read touched these datasets; no biological/physical finding or outcome for any candidate was read to produce this order, and none may be re-ranked after seeing results. Priority, in order: (1) meets or exceeds >=10 patients/environments for patient- or environment-disjoint folds -- every dataset below this threshold is ranked after every dataset that clears it, regardless of the remaining criteria; (2) richness of multivariate measurement among threshold-clearing datasets (independent modality count, feature dimensionality, whether an orthogonal assay is already co-measured); (3) whether an independent external replication route (Level 2) already has its data gated on-store vs. still requiring acquisition; (4) whether an orthogonal-modality (Level 3) route is already on-store; (5) scientific/actionability importance, including a native Level 4 perturbation/intervention route. Ties broken by n_entities descending. A dataset can be demoted below an otherwise-lower dataset by a documented leakage risk that a naive protocol would not control for (e.g. ground-truth labels physically present alongside blinded evaluation data).
